title: Maine Barn Weddings | R&SVP – Hio Ridge, Bridgton
description: Sunday weddings for up to 135 guests in a restored 1820 barn in Bridgton, Maine. Ceremony in the field, reception in the barn. Alcohol-free. May through October.
heading: Weddings
lede: A Sunday wedding on a farm that has been in one family since 1941. The ceremony in the field facing Pleasant Mountain, the reception under 206-year-old beams, and the two of you getting ready in the rooms next door.
hero_alt: Ceremony benches in the field at Hio Ridge, birches and the tree line behind

steps.title: Get ready in the ell
steps.body: A room for the bride and a room for the groom, steps from the barn. A mirror, a chair, a hook for the dress.

steps.title: Ceremony in the field
steps.body: Benches made from the barn's old floorboards, facing Pleasant Mountain. If it rains, you marry in the barn.

steps.title: Dinner under the beams
steps.body: Your caterer in the prep kitchen, your guests on the main floor and in the loft, the French doors open to the patio.

steps.title: Sunset on the patio
steps.body: String lights come on, the stone circle fills up, and the field goes gold.

sunday.heading: Why Sundays
sunday.body: We keep Saturday as our day of rest, so our weddings are on Sundays. For you it means a quieter weekend for your guests, a Monday to recover, and vendors who have the date open. [CONFIRM: wording Susan is comfortable with]

faq.q: How many guests can the barn hold?
faq.a: 135. That is the capacity on our town permit for any event.

faq.q: Can we have our ceremony outside?
faq.a: Yes. The ceremony field faces Pleasant Mountain, with benches made from the barn's old floorboards. In rain, the ceremony moves into the barn.

faq.q: Can we bring our own caterer?
faq.a: Yes. There is a prep kitchen with barn doors your caterer can close while they finish the meal.
No. We are an alcohol-free venue, and that is part of our town permit. Many couples tell us it makes for a family day.

closing.heading: Pick a Sunday in 2027
closing.body: Tell us the date you have in mind and about how many guests. We will set up a private tour and send the open dates.
